title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(牧野滋研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Makino Shigeru)
educationalGoal: General theme: Antenna using metamaterial technology Theme: Research on your own project theme. Through research activities, students will learn about the significance of research, the research process, the formulation of research plans, research methods, and presentations. Goal: Acquire new knowledge or create original results based on conventional research.
advice: This subject is the final subject of the project design process, including an introduction to project design, and is positioned as a subject that integrates the items learned in all subjects. The aim is to review basic subjects and acquire advanced expertise through experiments and theoretical studies on project themes. Have their own project theme and work alone or in groups. Hold weekly meetings and report on progress with technical reports. The annual schedule is as follows. 1st period: Determine the project theme to be implemented and create a project proposal. Provide project progress report at the end of the semester. It will be announced at the mid-term presentation in July. 2nd period: Review the project proposal and modify if necessary. Submit a project progress report at the end of the semester. Is compiled into a project report and presented at the public presentation examination committee. The main theme includes: The project theme is in parentheses. (1) Flat reflector antenna (reflector array antenna) (2) AMC substrate integrated antenna (metamaterial antenna)
requiredKnowledge: This subject is the final subject of the project design process, including an introduction to project design, and is positioned as a subject that integrates the items learned in all subjects.
